# We360.ai

> Workforce analytics software for productivity tracking, ROI measurement, and attrition prevention. India-first, used by 120K+ employees across 10K+ companies in 21+ countries. Pricing starts at ₹399 per user/month.

## Core

- [Homepage](https://www.we360.ai/): We360.ai homepage — workforce analytics software for productivity tracking, ROI measurement, and burnout prevention. ₹399/user/month, 120K+ users, 10K+ companies, 21+ countries.
- [Pricing](https://www.we360.ai/pricing): Plans and pricing — starts at ₹399 per user/month, free trial, no credit card required.
- [Demo](https://www.we360.ai/demo): Book a guided demo of We360.ai.
- [Security](https://www.we360.ai/security): Data security, privacy, and compliance practices.

## Solutions

- [Employee Monitoring](https://www.we360.ai/solutions/employee-monitoring): Employee monitoring — activity tracking, screenshots, productivity scoring.
- [Workforce Analytics](https://www.we360.ai/solutions/workforce-analytics): Workforce analytics — utilization, capacity, and performance insights.
- [Time Tracker](https://www.we360.ai/solutions/time-tracker): Time tracking — automated, no manual timers.
- [Employee Tracking](https://www.we360.ai/solutions/employee-tracking): Employee tracking for in-office, remote, and hybrid teams.
- [Field Tracking](https://www.we360.ai/solutions/field-tracking): Field-force tracking — location-aware productivity for field teams.
- [Wfh Monitoring](https://www.we360.ai/solutions/wfh-monitoring): Work-from-home monitoring for distributed teams.
- [Operations It](https://www.we360.ai/solutions/operations-it): Workforce analytics for Operations and IT teams.
- [Finance](https://www.we360.ai/solutions/finance): Workforce analytics for Finance teams — audit-ready visibility for CFOs.

## Features

- [Productivity Tracking](https://www.we360.ai/features/productivity-tracking): Productivity tracking — app/website usage, focus time, trends.
- [Application And Website Usage](https://www.we360.ai/features/application-and-website-usage): Application and website usage tracking.
- [Attendance Insights](https://www.we360.ai/features/attendance-insights): Attendance insights — automated presence and shift analytics.
- [Employee Dashboard](https://www.we360.ai/features/employee-dashboard): Employee dashboard — self-serve productivity view for every employee.
- [Screenshots](https://www.we360.ai/features/screenshots): Periodic screenshots with privacy controls.
- [Screen Recording](https://www.we360.ai/features/screen-recording): Screen recording for compliance-sensitive workflows.
- [Livestream](https://www.we360.ai/features/livestream): Live screen view for real-time support and training.
- [Timesheet](https://www.we360.ai/features/timesheet): Automated timesheets generated from real activity data.
- [Reports](https://www.we360.ai/features/reports): Reports — scheduled and on-demand workforce reporting.
- [Wellness](https://www.we360.ai/features/wellness): Wellness — workload balance and burnout-risk signals.
- [Cost Intelligence](https://www.we360.ai/features/cost-intelligence): Cost intelligence — productivity cost and hidden-capacity analysis.
- [Agentic Ai](https://www.we360.ai/features/agentic-ai): Agentic AI — AI assistant for workforce insights.
- [Ai Tools Usage Tracking](https://www.we360.ai/features/ai-tools-usage-tracking): AI tools usage tracking — ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, Claude adoption and ROI.
- [Ai Optimization Spend](https://www.we360.ai/features/ai-optimization-spend): AI spend optimization — find unused AI licenses and recover waste.
- [Employee Retention Risk Analysis](https://www.we360.ai/features/employee-retention-risk-analysis): AI-powered retention risk and attrition prediction.
- [Executive Insights](https://www.we360.ai/features/executive-insights): Executive insights — hidden capacity and financial-loss analysis for leadership.
- [Attrition Risk](https://www.we360.ai/features/attrition-risk): Attrition-risk signals from work-pattern analysis.
- [Activity Tracking](https://www.we360.ai/features/activity-tracking): Activity tracking — keyboard, mouse, and idle-time signals.
